In context

ScaleSchool ERP useOther use
● SuccessPresent, Paid, Active, SubmittedValidation success, status badge
● WarningLate attendance, Pending fee, Low gradeCautionary alert, soft-blocking states
● DangerAbsent, Overdue, Failing grade, Account disabledDestructive actions, errors
● InfoAnnouncements, neutral notes, system messagesTips, callouts

Rules

Never use colour alone — pair with an icon or text label so colour-blind users read the same status.
Use the -light variant for backgrounds, the base for solid surfaces, and -text for text-on-light pairings.
Never invent a fifth severity. If you need "neutral," use the slate neutral tokens.
